    70→  };
    71→  return zoneInfo[zone];
    72→}

    74→/**
    75→ * PowerDisplay props
    76→ */
    77→export interface PowerDisplayProps extends AccessibilityProps {
    78→  /** Current power in watts */
    79→  power: number;
    80→  /** 3-second average power */
    81→  power3sAvg: number;
    82→  /** Current power zone */

    86→  /** Whether metrics are available to display */

    88→  /** Custom container style */

    90→}
    91→
    92→/**
    93→ * PowerDisplay Component
    94→ *
    95→ * A large, prominent power display showing current watts, 3-second average,
    96→ * and power zone with color coding. Displays target power during workouts.
    97→ *
    98→ * @example
    99→ * ```tsx
   100→ * <PowerDisplay
   101→ *   power={285}
   102→ *   power3sAvg={280}
   103→ *   powerZone="threshold"
   104→ *   targetPower={275}
   105→ *   showMetrics={true}
   106→ * />
   107→ * ```
   108→ */
   109→export function PowerDisplay({
   110→  power,
   111→  power3sAvg,
   112→  powerZone,
   113→  targetPower,
   114→  showMetrics = true,
   115→  style,
   116→  ...accessibilityProps
   117→}: PowerDisplayProps): React.JSX.Element {
   118→  const { colors, spacing, typography, borderRadius } = useTheme();
   119→
   120→  // Get zone display info
   121→  const zoneInfo = useMemo(() => getZoneDisplayInfo(powerZone), [powerZone]);
   122→
   123→  // Calculate power difference from target
   124→  const powerDiff = useMemo(() => {
   125→    if (targetPower == null || !showMetrics) {
   126→      return null;
   127→    }
   128→    return power - targetPower;
   129→  }, [power, targetPower, showMetrics]);
   130→
   131→  // Determine if power is within acceptable range of target (±5%)
   132→  const isOnTarget = useMemo(() => {
   133→    if (targetPower == null || !showMetrics) {
   134→      return null;
   135→    }
   136→    const tolerance = targetPower * 0.05;
   137→    return Math.abs(power - targetPower) <= tolerance;
   138→  }, [power, targetPower, showMetrics]);
   139→
   140→  // Build accessibility label
   141→  const accessibilityLabel =
   142→    accessibilityProps.accessibilityLabel ||
   143→    `Power: ${showMetrics ? power : 'no data'} watts, ` +
   144→      `3 second average: ${showMetrics ? power3sAvg : 'no data'} watts, ` +
   145→      `Zone: ${showMetrics ? zoneInfo.label : 'none'}` +
   146→      (targetPower != null ? `, Target: ${targetPower} watts` : '');
   147→
   148→  return (
   149→    <View
   150→      style={[
   151→        styles.container,
   152→        {
   153→          backgroundColor: colors.card,
   154→          borderRadius: borderRadius.lg,
   155→          padding: spacing.lg,
   156→          borderLeftWidth: showMetrics && power > 0 ? 5 : 0,
   157→          borderLeftColor: showMetrics && power > 0 ? zoneInfo.color : 'transparent',
   158→        },
   159→        style,
   160→      ]}
   161→      accessible
   162→      accessibilityRole="text"
   163→      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
   164→      {...accessibilityProps}
   165→    >
   166→      {/* Header with label and zone indicator */}
   167→      <View style={styles.header}>
   168→        <Text
   169→          style={[
   170→            styles.label,
   171→            typography.textStyles.metricLabel,
   172→            { color: colors.textMuted },
   173→          ]}
   174→        >
   175→          POWER
   176→        </Text>
   177→        {showMetrics && power > 0 && (
   178→          <View
   179→            style={[
   180→              styles.zoneBadge,
   181→              { backgroundColor: zoneInfo.color },
   182→            ]}
   183→          >
   184→            <Text style={[styles.zoneBadgeText, { color: '#FFFFFF' }]}>
   185→              {zoneInfo.shortLabel} {zoneInfo.label}
   186→            </Text>
   187→          </View>
   188→        )}
   189→      </View>
   190→
   191→      {/* Main power value */}
   192→      <View style={styles.mainValueRow}>
   193→        <Text
   194→          style={[
   195→            styles.mainValue,
   196→            typography.textStyles.metricPrimary,
   197→            { color: showMetrics && power > 0 ? zoneInfo.color : colors.textPrimary },
   198→          ]}
